mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.issue_id, t.user_id, t.work_date, t.duration, t.start_time, t.description, t.created_at, t.updated_at, i.issue_key, i.title AS issue_title, p.id AS project_id, p.name AS project_name, p.key AS project_key, wiav.name AS work_type, wiav.id AS work_type_id, wiav.color AS work_type_color FROM time_entry t JOIN issue i ON i.id = t.issue_id JOIN project p ON p.id = i.project_id LEFT JOIN time_entry_attribute_value teav ON teav.time_entry_id = t.id AND teav.attribute_id = 1 LEFT JOIN work_item_attribute_value wiav ON wiav.id = teav.value_id WHERE i.project_id IN ( SELECT pm.project_id FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} ) AND t.work_date >= #{startDate}::date AND t.work_date <= #{endDate}::date ORDER BY p.name ASC, t.work_date ASC, t.start_time ASC, t.created_at ASC

SELECT t.id, t.issue_id, t.user_id, t.work_date, t.duration, t.start_time, t.description, t.created_at, t.updated_at, i.issue_key, i.title AS issue_title, u.display_name AS user_name, wiav.name AS work_type, wiav.id AS work_type_id, wiav.color AS work_type_color FROM time_entry t JOIN issue i ON i.id = t.issue_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN time_entry_attribute_value teav ON teav.time_entry_id = t.id AND teav.attribute_id = 1 LEFT JOIN work_item_attribute_value wiav ON wiav.id = teav.value_id WHERE i.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.work_date >= #{startDate}::date AND t.work_date <= #{endDate}::date ORDER BY t.work_date ASC, t.start_time ASC, t.created_at ASC
